To find the antiderivative of log(x), I'll use integration by parts.

Let me set up the problem:
- Let f = ln(x), so df = (1/x) dx
- Let dg = dx, so g = x

Using the formula ∫f dg = f·g - ∫g df:

∫ ln(x) dx = x·ln(x) - ∫ x · (1/x) dx = x·ln(x) - ∫ dx

= x·ln(x) - x

**Verification:** d/dx [x·ln(x) - x] = ln(x) + x·(1/x) - 1 = ln(x) + 1 - 1 = ln(x) ✓

<answer>
x*ln(x) - x
</answer>
